window-1.title: WigglyPaint
window-1.blurb: Every line you draw squirms and squeaks like it's alive, and you can export the whole wobbly mess as a GIF — it's the most charmingly imperfect drawing tool on the internet and I fully expect to see it in your next persona shoot's title cards.

window-2.title: Colossal
window-2.blurb: It's a daily drip of people who went way too far on a handmade idea — thread portraits, stop-motion obsessives, clay worlds — and you'll come away with three new side quests before lunch.

window-4.title: A Clinton Hill Brownstone with Chinese Inflections by Bespoke Only
window-4.blurb: It's 19th-century Shanghai smuggled into a Brooklyn brownstone — proof you can build heritage into a room as texture and mood instead of hanging it on the wall like a souvenir.
